scope: Synchronous application/controller interfaces of actual EP1/EP2 FIFOs, no internal force or PHY model
limits: No metastability/physical CDC, analogue PHY or cable qualification.
ACK/POP are kept on their original endpoint; idle EP2 strobes are deliberately not invented.
Coincident ACK+POP on EP2 occurs only after the complete advertised payload was consumed.
Expected production defects remain recorded as failing simulations.
